comparison_config.experiment: paired Intel replay: change route-scoring objective only
comparison_config.target: original 0.75 m reachable evaluation grid at the fixed mission deadline
comparison_config.normalization: fixed initial maximum single-event gain for each objective; no clipping or label tuning
comparison_config.simulation_time_model: unchanged: travel + acquisition waiting + dwell; online computation charged as zero
comparison_config.note: Single fixed recorded dataset; no statistical superiority or ROS deployment claim.

catalog.normalization: Maximum initial single-event gain over the fixed availability catalog. Fixed across policies and replans. Route scores may exceed one; never clipped.

evaluation: Unchanged 28 held-out real records in the final five minutes. Retrospective reconstruction, not future forecasting. No dense measured truth.
policy_target: Uniform mean latent variance over the original reachable grid, at the fixed mission deadline. No measured labels enter this target.
normalization_weights_note: 50/50 is an explicit initial hypothesis, not a validated optimum. Fixed initial single-event scales give equal relative weights, not equal physical units.
